platform.title: Platform brand
platform.description: Name, color, logo and contacts shown on the platform domains and to direct customers.

form.contrastHint: Text and accent colors are calculated to keep a minimum contrast of 4.5:1 in the light and dark themes.
form.logo: Logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 256 KB)

sections.identityHint: Name, tagline and color used in the dashboard, on the login and in emails.
sections.imagesHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP images only (the favicon takes a square PNG or ICO). SVG is not accepted because it can carry scripts.
sections.contactHint: Shown on the login and in the footer of public screens.
sections.previewHint: How the login looks with the values above, before saving.

form.logoDark: Dark theme logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 256 KB)
form.logoDarkHint: Without it, the dark theme uses the main logo.
form.favicon: Favicon (square PNG or ICO, up to 64 KB)
form.shareImage: Share image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB)
form.shareImageHint: Shown when a dashboard link is shared. Recommended size: 1200 x 630.
form.footerHint: Plain text. https:// addresses become links.
form.whatsappNumber: Sales WhatsApp (with country and area code, optional)

errors.logoTooLarge: The logo must be at most 256 KB.
errors.logoUnsupportedType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP logo.
errors.invalidWhatsapp: Use the number with country and area code.
errors.faviconTooLarge: The favicon must be at most 64 KB.
errors.faviconUnsupportedType: Use a PNG or ICO favicon.
errors.shareImageEmpty: The share image file is empty.
errors.shareImageTooLarge: The share image must be at most 512 KB.
errors.shareImageUnsupportedType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP share image.
